headline_marked: Govt to [[ensure Shakib Al Hasan's security]] if he returns to face cases
headline: Govt to ensure Shakib Al Hasan's security if he returns to face cases
summary: Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman says the cricketer will receive full security if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal proceedings.
details: Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman stated that there is no need to worry about the security of cricketer Shakib Al Hasan if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal cases.
The statement comes after Shakib told Reuters that he would return to face the cases against him provided he is guaranteed security.
Dr. Zahed dismissed the possibility of any attacks or mob violence against the cricketer at the airport or elsewhere, asserting that the legal process will be place under full security.
However, the advisor strongly criticized Shakib's personal character, calling him a 'rotten and decayed person' despite being a great player, due to his associations with former PM Sheikh Hasina.
Dr. Zahed described Shakib's recent interviews and statements as 'propaganda' and an attempt to create pressure on the government.

The advisor also mentioned that while the government will not allow a 'fascist mafia regime' to return, any citizen, including Shakib and former PM Sheikh Hasina, will be granted their constitutional and judicial rights.
He added that the court's decision regarding those facing trial will be accepted by all.
caption:
Will Shakib Al Hasan return to Bangladesh? The government says he will be safe, but the advisor calls him a 'rotten' person.

Prime Minister's Information Advisor Dr. Zahed Ur Rahman stated that there is no need to worry about the security of cricketer Shakib Al Hasan if he returns to Bangladesh to face legal cases.

The statement comes after Shakib told Reuters that he would return to face the cases against him provided he is guaranteed security.

Dr. Zahed dismissed the possibility of any attacks or mob violence against the cricketer at the airport or elsewhere, asserting that the legal process will be place under full security.

However, the advisor strongly criticized Shakib's personal character, calling him a 'rotten and decayed person' despite being a great player, due to his associations with former PM Sheikh Hasina.

Dr. Zahed described Shakib's recent interviews and statements as 'propaganda' and an attempt to create pressure on the government.

The advisor also mentioned that while the government will not allow a 'fascist mafia regime' to return, any citizen, including Shakib and former PM Sheikh Hasina, will be granted their constitutional and judicial rights.

He added that the court's decision regarding those facing trial will be accepted by all.

headline: 4 detained as Awami League tries to hold flash rally in Mohakhali
summary: Police intervened as 30-40 people gathered for a rally by the banned party; others escaped after detonating cocktails.
details: Police have detained four individuals after an attempt to hold a flash rally under the banner of the banned Awami League in the Mohakhali area of Dhaka.
The incident occurred around 1:30 PM on Tuesday near the Public Health Institute and CM Pump in Mohakhali, where 30-40 people gathered.
According to Banani Police Station, the detainees include Aslam Mia and Ashikul Islam, activists of the banned Chhatra League, and Awami League activists Mahfuzur Rahman Siam and Monir Hossain.
The police stated that while they were attempting to arrest the group, several individuals detonated cocktails to facilitate their escape.
One person was reportedly beaten by a local crowd before being handed over to the Mohakhali Terminal police outpost.
Banani Police Station OC Muhammad Faridul Islam confirmed that the individuals arrived at the scene in CNG auto-rickshaws and that the injured person is receiving primary medical treatment.
caption:
